project.name: BLADE Media SPI
project.description:
The stable contract shared by the BLADE framework, its media applications, and a JSR-309 media driver: the extra JSR-309 Configurations (MediaConfigs), the failover-recovery and out-of-band-DTMF hooks a driver factory implements (MediaSessionRecovery, DtmfSink), and the SFU forwarding capability (SelectiveForwarder). Every type here depends only on javax.media.mscontrol.* and javax.servlet.sip.*, so a driver compiles and loads against this jar alone with no framework linkage.
This jar is deployed on the classloader that loads the driver (the domain lib/ extension classpath, or the OCCAS native 309-loader path), NOT bundled in each WAR: the parent POM's WAR packagingExcludes strips it from WEB-INF/lib, so a WAR resolves these types from that shared parent. One Class per type across both tiers is what makes the framework's `factory instanceof MediaSessionRecovery` and the `config == MediaConfigs.WEBRTC` check hold when the driver is deployed apart from the app. See gryphon/gryphon-jsr309.
